info.title: FloFi Developer API
info.summary: Developers build the experience. FloFi handles the DeFi workflow lifecycle.
info.description: Server-side API for third-party applications: discover capabilities, store immutable FloFi strategies, validate and simulate them, and hand them to the end user for approval in FloFi. The API key has zero financial authority: it never signs, submits or approves anything. Only the end user's own wallet, in FloFi, after a fresh simulation and the Strategy Manifest Review, can sign. Execution status and evidence are visible only for runs the end user chose to share (off by default). Sandbox credentials only in this release: test funds, every mainnet off.

parameters.description: The event id: the same on every retry and endpoint.

parameters.description: `v1,` + base64 HMAC-SHA-256 of `<webhook-id>.<webhook-timestamp>.<raw body>` under the endpoint secret's base64 key.
